subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired version of this draft serializer, or leave it waiting on the contributor to rebase and address the delivery-lane blockers?
rationale: The user-visible bug is real and proven, but the current branch is draft, dirty, and needs non-trivial owner-boundary repairs before it is mergeable.

options.title: Repair Before Merge
options.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue/platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh proof.

options.title: Wait For Author
options.body: Keep this PR open as a contributor draft and require a rebase plus fixes before another merge-readiness review.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer PR
options.body: Close this branch only after a maintainer-owned replacement lands the same ordering fix with stronger queue semantics.

recommendation.title: Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue/platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame points to vincentkoc for both the outbound queue placement and the shared keyed queue helper a repair should reuse.
